description: Searches the Stablevoy documentation for how-to questions. Needs no key. Topics: connecting a shop, stores, webhooks and their signatures, networks and fees, the payment widget, the plugins, recovery. A section ranks higher for each query word it contains. It ranks higher still when the word is in its heading or page title. Two to four specific words work best, for example "webhook signature" or "Tron fee". Each hit has the page title, its path for get_doc, the page address, the heading and up to 2000 characters of the section. Only the best 5 hits come back and there is no paging, so use other words to reach other sections. An empty list means no word matched. Call get_doc with a path to read the whole page. This running server keeps the pages for an hour, so searching again makes no request.

query.description: 2 to 200 characters: the words to look for, for example "webhook retries". Case is ignored. Words shorter than 2 letters and common words such as "the", "how" and "to" are dropped, so a query of only those matches nothing.

name: search_docs
title: Search the Stablevoy documentation
